title: Re-Fresh🔄️
description: A new style of play! Kill player for their refresh points to upgrade yourself!
body:
**========================
 Re-Fresh Season Effects; 
 Stages: -5 to 10; 
 Negative = Buffs (Fresh); 
 Positive = Debuffs (Stale); 
 Stage 10 = Perma-ban; 
========================**

Gain 1 "Freshness" per death and loose one per kill.

Amazing and fun to add to servers! Creats a difficult environment for more exprenced players.

As you see, the debuffs go lower than the buffs, and there is a crafting recipe for loosing them down to zero.

I don't know why I did it in reverse, I think thats just how I wanted to do it at the time.

### Key And Pattern For Recipe:

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

"key": {
    "C": "diamond_block",
    "R": "minecraft:ender_eye",
    "V": "minecraft:netherite_upgrade_smithing_template",
    "D": "minecraft:ancient_debris",
    "F": "minecraft:emerald_block"
  },
  "pattern": [
    "CCC",
    "RVR",
    "DFD"
    ]

</details>

There is an info dialog box called info_box, you will need to compleatly restart a world or server to accsses it though.
